messages.subject: [IT] Planned DMS maintenance - Saturday 4 October, 07:00-11:00
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday 4 October between 07:00 and 11:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please check in any documents you are working on before Friday close of business. Email and calendar are unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
